reasoning: Recent Georgia Senate polling in the last 45 days shows Democrat Jon Ossoff leading Republican Mike Collins by between about 4 and 13 points, with the most recent major poll showing a 9-point Ossoff advantage. Georgia’s statewide Cook PVI is R+6, indicating the state leans Republican even though the current Senate polling favors the Democrat.

sources.name: AARP
sources.details: AARP poll of 1,060 likely Georgia voters found Ossoff leading Collins 52% to 43%, a 9-point Democratic margin.

sources.name: Wick
sources.details: Wick survey of 1,175 likely voters found Ossoff ahead 46.7% to 42.9%, a 3.8-point Democratic margin.

sources.name: Fox News / Beacon Research
sources.details: Fox News / Beacon Research poll reported by USA Today found Ossoff leading Collins 56% to 43%, a 13-point Democratic margin.

sources.name: Pollsmax polling average
sources.details: Polling average aggregator reported Georgia Senate polling average at 48.5% D to 42.4% R, a 6.1-point Democratic margin, based on seven polls.
